methodologyNotes: 14 water-softener products verified against manufacturer pages, major retailers, and third-party review sources on 2026-06-26. GE products confirmed via geappliances.com (both discontinued but still listed with prices). Whirlpool WHES30E price confirmed at $698.94 via cleanwatermill.com. Whirlpool WHES40E price $629.99 confirmed via Fleet Farm search result. Rheem RHW42 listed at $689 Home Depot regular price ($639 with credit card promo); RHS42 at $549-$589 depending on retailer. A.O. Smith prices confirmed at $549/$649 via waterdefense.org review. WaterBoss 700 at $529.99 (Anderson Lumber). WaterBoss 900 in $550-$580 range across retailers. Morton prices not directly confirmed from Menards (bot-blocked) but product models verified on mortonwatersofteners.com. NuvoH2O Manor DPMB at $999.99 via purewaterguys.com confirmed. EcoPure EP42 has no manufacturer-listed price (sold through retail channel only). Rheem RHW42 price corrected from $639 to $689 (regular Home Depot price; $639 is promo-only). WaterBoss 700 price corrected from $562.53 to $529.99 per Anderson Lumber. specKeys: grainCapacity (thousands of grains rated capacity), systemType (ion-exchange or salt-free), flowRateGpm (service flow rate in GPM), saltEfficiencyLbsPerKGrains (lbs salt per 1000 grains regenerated, lower=better; null if salt-free), ironRemovalPpm (max clear water iron removal in ppm), nsfCertifications (NSF/ANSI standard numbers or boolean), smartAppControl (WiFi/app enabled boolean), tankWarrantyYears (tank/mineral tank warranty in years), msrpUsd (MSRP or regular retail price in USD).

products.name: SpringWell SS1 Salt-Based Water Softener (32,000 Grain)
products.priceNote: $1,620.00 (shown with a "Sale!" tag) is the base/default variation price on the SpringWell manufacturer product page; the 1-3 Bathroom configuration in the spec table is the SS1 (32K grain). Buy-box subtotal displays as $1620.00 for the softener alone (bypass valve is a separate add-on line). Some older third-party reviews cite $1,399-$1,495, but the live manufacturer figure ($1,620.00) is used.
products.provenance: The SpringWell manufacturer product page carries a per-model specification table that explicitly lists the SS1: GRAIN 32K, FLOW RATE 11 GPM SERVICE, 1-3 Bathrooms, 1" connection, 25-80 PSI, and the page describes the salt-based ion-exchange process driven by a Bluetooth app-controlled "Connected Series" metered valve head; the base (default 1-3 bathroom) price is shown as $1,620.00 with a Sale tag. The Quality Water Lab review independently corroborates the SS1 as salt-based / ion exchange, metered regeneration, 32,000 grain capacity, 11 GPM flow, Bluetooth app control, and a lifetime warranty. Iron-removal ppm, a specific NSF/ANSI standard number, and a numeric lbs-per-1000-grains salt efficiency are not stated for this model (the softener warranty in fact excludes iron-bearing water), so those keys are null. Tank warranty is marketed as "lifetime" rather than a fixed year count — a conflicting generic 10-year clause applies only to mineral/retention tanks 14 inches or larger, while the SS1 tank is 9 inches — so tankWarrantyYears is left null.

products.name: Fleck 5600SXT 48,000 Grain Metered Water Softener
products.priceNote: $799.00 base configuration (8% cross-linked resin) at AffordableWater.us (SKU AW-S56SXT48). AFWFilters lists the same exact system (SKU WS48-56SXT) at $901.00 standard price / $759.00 sale. Typical street price ~$759-799 for the 48,000-grain build; no single manufacturer MSRP exists because this is an assembler-packaged system.
products.provenance: AFWFilters product page (SKU WS48-56SXT, the exact "Fleck 5600SXT 48,000 Grain Water Softener Digital SXT Metered Whole House System") confirms verbatim: 48,000 grain / 1.5 cubic feet of high capacity 8% cross linked resin, ion-exchange operation ("Using ion exchange process this system removes the calcium and magnesium"), "up to 12 gpm service flow rates (28 GPM peak)", a 5-year valve warranty and a 10-year tank warranty, priced $901.00 standard / $759.00 sale. AffordableWater.us (SKU AW-S56SXT48) corroborates the same exact 48,000-grain / 1.5 cu ft model at $799.00 (Current/Original price verbatim), with a 10-year 10"x54" resin-tank warranty and a rated flow of 13 gpm at 15 psi drop. Salt efficiency per 1,000 grains, iron-removal ppm, and NSF/ANSI certification are not stated on either page (the resin is "tested and certified by the Water Quality Assn." — a WQA listing, not NSF/ANSI), so those specKeys are null. msrpUsd is also null: neither page states a manufacturer's suggested retail price (AFWFilters' MSRP field is blank; the $799 is AffordableWater's selling price, captured in priceUsd) and no manufacturer MSRP exists for this assembler-packaged system. Model verified as the exact 5600SXT 48,000-grain metered build on both pages, not a sibling capacity or variant.

products.name: Aquasana SimplySoft 40,000 Grain Water Softener (WH-SF40)
products.priceNote: $1,698.00 as-configured base system price on aquasana.com (manufacturer page shows "As Configured $1,698.00" with both optional upgrades — Low Maintenance Pre-Filter +$300 and Easy Connect Kit +$100 — set to No). Water Filter Comparisons cites a $799.99 Amazon "System" price explicitly "accurate as of 9/2/2022," which is stale; the current manufacturer-listed as-configured price is $1,698.00. Home Depot, Amazon, and Walmart listings for WH-SF40 were previously bot-blocked (403/robot check) so their current price could not be verified verbatim.
products.provenance: Verified against the Aquasana manufacturer product page (aquasana.com, model WH-SF40, item 100381840). Its PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS table confirms verbatim: Grain Capacity 40,000, Rated Flow Rate 11.02 GPM (Peak Flow Rate 15.5 GPM), Salt Storage Capacity 230 pounds, Max Hardness 200 gpg. Body copy states "SimplySoft® uses ion exchange" and "IAPMO certified to NSF/ANSI Standard 44 for the reduction of water hardness and to CSA B483.1." Control interface is described only as a "fully customizable control panel" with an "LCD display" (no WiFi/app; FAQ notes a 12V AC power adapter), supporting smartAppControl=false. The page shows "As Configured $1,698.00" (both upgrades set to No). The page states a "5/10-Year Limited Warranty" but does NOT break out which components carry the 10-year term; the tank-specific 10-year figure is not verbatim on either fetched page (it was previously attributed to a warranty PDF that is not among the fetched source/corroboration URLs), so tankWarrantyYears was nulled. Water Filter Comparisons corroborates the exact WH-SF40 model with "Certified IAPMO 44, CSA B483.1," Integrate Pre-Filter Yes, "Salt Technology No," ion exchange, and a "5/10-year warranty" (its System price of $799.99 is explicitly "accurate as of 9/2/2022"). Iron-removal ppm and numeric salt efficiency are not stated on any fetched page, so both remain null.

products.name: DROP Smart Water Softener (S-32, 32,000 Grain)
products.priceNote: $3,441.00 USD is the regular price shown on the DROP manufacturer store (dropconnect.com) for the DROP Smart Water Softener, corresponding to the base 32,000-grain option (model S-32). The store also lists 48,000-grain and 64,000-grain grain options, but their prices were not shown on the fetched page (both displayed as "Variant sold out or unavailable"). Both the store and the cut sheet state the softener requires the separately sold DROP Hub to function; the Hub's price was not shown on either fetched page. (Prior draft figures of $3,725.00 for S-48, $4,200.00 for S-64, and $443.00 for the Hub were not present in the fetched sources and have been removed.)
products.provenance: The DROP (Chandler Systems) manufacturer store page confirms the product "DROP Smart Water Softeners," offered in 32000/48000/64000 grain options, DROP App-controlled and requiring the DROP Hub to function. The page displays a single regular price of $3,441.00 USD for the base option and does not show prices for the larger options or for the Hub. The DROP-branded Smart Water Softener cut sheet documents models S-32/S-48/S-64 and confirms the S-32 configuration: 27,000 grains rated at the 9 lb factory salt setting ("Factory Salt Setting: 9 lbs / ft3"), 10.0 gpm service flow rate, 5 ppm maximum clear iron/manganese, 1.0 ft3 exchange resin, demand-initiated regeneration, DROP App control, and a general 5-year warranty. grainCapacity is recorded as 32 per the store's nominal grain-option label (32000) for the base S-32; the cut sheet's 27,000-grain figure is the salt-setting-dependent rated capacity for that same unit. systemType "ion-exchange" is supported by the cut sheet's exchange resin, brine tank, and salt-per-regeneration figures (salt-based softener). flowRateGpm (10.0 gpm) and ironRemovalPpm (5 ppm) are taken verbatim from the cut sheet's S-32 column. nsfCertifications and a specific tank/mineral-tank warranty term were not stated on either fetched page (only a general 5-year warranty), so both are null; saltEfficiency is left null as no lbs-per-1000-grains figure is stated verbatim. Exact model confirmed as the base S-32 (not a sibling S-48/S-64). Fabricated sibling/Hub prices from the prior draft were removed after re-fetch; no supported change to priceUsd/msrpUsd ($3,441.00 appears verbatim).

products.name: Aquasure Harmony Series 48,000 Grain Digital Metered Water Softener (AS-HS48D)
products.priceNote: $629.99 regular price on the manufacturer site aquasureusa.com (shown verbatim as "Regular price $629.99"). Corroborated at $629.00 on FactoryPure, an authorized Aquasure dealer. iFilters lists the same AS-HS48D in EUR (€537.95).
products.provenance: The Aquasure manufacturer page (aquasureusa.com) confirms the AS-HS48D Harmony Series 48,000-grain rating, an "ion exchange process," an automatic digital metered control head, and a regular price of $629.99; it does not publish a numeric spec table (no flow rate, salt efficiency, iron ppm, or NSF certification), and a customer review on that page explicitly states it is not NSF 44 certified. FactoryPure (an authorized Aquasure dealer) confirms model AS-HS48D at $629.00 with a spec table listing "48,000 Grains of Hardness," "Cation Resin Media" (ion exchange), 1" NPT connection, 62"H x 10"W x 10"D dimensions, and a "5 Year limited manufacturer warranty" (stated multiple times). No control-head description on either page mentions app/WiFi/Bluetooth connectivity, so smartAppControl is false. No fetched page states a numeric service flow rate (GPM), salt efficiency, iron-removal ppm, or NSF/ANSI certification, so those keys are null. iFilters is referenced only as supplementary EUR pricing/warranty context and was not re-fetched in this verification.

verifierNotes: All 14 products pass verification. No rejections. Key corrections: (1) Rheem RHW42 price corrected from $639 to $689 -- the $639 figure was a Home Depot credit card promotional price, not the regular retail price. (2) WaterBoss 700 price corrected from $562.53 to $529.99 per Anderson Lumber and Do It Best confirmed pricing. (3) NuvoH2O Manor DPMB price of $999.99 confirmed at PureWaterGuys.com (manufacturer direct is $1,094.99). (4) EcoPure EP42 null price is legitimate -- manufacturer does not list MSRP and sells exclusively through retail channel. (5) WaterBoss grain capacities confirmed: 700=22K, 900=36.4K (manufacturer also references 38K at max salt dose but 36.4K is the standard rated spec). (6) GE GXSH40V and GXSF30V are discontinued but still listed with pricing on geappliances.com. (7) A.O. Smith AO-WH-SOFT-450T may be transitioning off Lowe's website. (8) Morton prices could not be directly verified at Menards due to bot blocking, but products confirmed on mortonwatersofteners.com and prices are consistent with third-party references. All 9 specKeys present on all products (with nulls where data unavailable). All slugs valid per regex pattern.
